text: ポケモンは　つかう　ひとに　よって　よくも　わるくも　なる　パートナーだと　おもうの

structure.jp: つかう　ひとに　よって
structure.en: depending on the person who uses them

structure.jp: よくも　わるくも　なる　パートナーだと
structure.en: are partners that become good or bad

patterns.name: 〜によって
patterns.explanation: によって after a thing means 'depending on' it. ひとによって = 'depending on the person'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: パートナーだと　おもう
patterns.explanation: と before おもう wraps up what is being thought, like 'that' in English. パートナーだとおもう = 'I think that they are partners'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.span: よくも　わるくも　なる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with い changed to く, followed by なる, means 'become' that. The two も mean 'both this and that'. よくもわるくもなる = 'become either good or bad'.
